scientific_question: Do zero-error component quotients determine bounded target-only decision risk, and when is full expanded-parameter deficiency conservative because it prices nuisance information irrelevant to the target?

estimands.zero_error_object: connected components of the registered confusability graph
estimands.target_only_risk: exact minimax 0-1 risk over the registered nuisance states
estimands.deficiency_conservatism_gap: expanded-parameter deficiency minus the maximum positive target-only minimax-risk gap over the four registered decisions

solver_contract.floating_point_role: SciPy HiGHS may propose active constraints only
solver_contract.accepted_optimum: Every accepted value must have matching exact rational primal and dual certificates.
solver_contract.failure_rule: Failure to construct an exact certificate stops execution; a floating optimum is never an outcome.

fixed_gates.condition: Exactly 4,096 confirmation experiments, four decisions, and both frozen observation semantics are evaluated.
The classical finite anchor has deficiency 0 from informative to uninformative and 1/4 in the reverse direction.
All 100 frozen anchor experiment/decision comparisons satisfy target-risk gap <= directional deficiency.
Under each observation semantic, at least one connected-component quotient contains multiple exact risk profiles with strictly positive within-quotient spread.
The nuisance-only witness has expanded-parameter deficiency 1/2, maximum registered target-only risk gap 0, and therefore strict conservatism.

decision_rule: All five gates must pass. Any failure yields not_established for the bounded instrument without changing the grid, decisions, semantics, or thresholds.

resource_envelope.note: The release receipt reports resources. These are validity ceilings, not theorem assumptions.

claim_boundary: This is an exact finite instrument consolidation. Blackwell comparison, Le Cam deficiency, nuisance-parameter comparison, zero-error confusability, and the risk-transfer inequality are classical. A passing result would show only that the registered finite ASMP-9 ledger separates quotient, risk, and nuisance-sensitive deficiency. It would not establish a new comparison theorem, characterize general demonstrators, identify a real reward, or resolve ASMP-9.
